    Compare APM Competitors
    See how we compare to Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace, and more.
  • Features
    Rendering absence (spatial rendering of absence: phantom services and missing spans)
    The service that should be there and isn't, the span that never arrived, rendered as a gap in the map.
    Live topology (the map moves because the system moves)
    The layout is not fixed, on purpose. What persists is not a coordinate but a relationship.
    Immersion (immersive 3D environment navigation)
    Step into the running topology and move through it. Navigate by looking: see it, go to it.
    Live, and it holds still
    Live telemetry flowing through the space as it happens, not a refreshed rollup.
    Frozen moment (freeze the scene and walk around inside it)
    Hit pause and the incident stops around you, held in place while you walk over and look.
    AI partner, not a sidebar (Tessa AI assistant with codebase access)
    Ask it, then check its work: Tessa shows its reasoning and the evidence, and reads your code, not just your telemetry.
    Full-stack view (360 full-stack spatial observability)
    Every service, dependency, and signal in a single 3D view, not scattered across tabs.
  • Integrations
    OpenTelemetry (OTel-native ingestion, OTLP, no proprietary agents)
    Standard OTLP in and out. Point your existing exporter at DeepCube, no proprietary agents, your data stays portable.
    MCP Server (open-source Model Context Protocol server on GitHub, for VS Code and GitHub Copilot agent mode)
    Query your live telemetry in plain language from VS Code and GitHub Copilot. Open-source.
    Steam
    Install the 3D client from Steam. Same product, delivered through the platform you already use.
  • Use Cases
    Development/Operations (DevOps) Teams
    Find root causes by seeing the whole system at once, spatial diagnostics over dashboard-hopping.
    Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Teams
    Spot the gap in the map before it pages you. Navigate incidents in 3D.
    Infrastructure Teams
    See what's running and what shouldn't be, live topology instead of static inventory.
    Support Enablement
    Make understanding visual. Reproduce and walk issues in a shared space.
    Education & Academia
    Students see systems, not dashboards. Academic research shows 3D visualization improves comprehension by 22-30%.

The bug your dashboard can't draw

A service that should be calling and isn't. A span that never arrived. Flat tools only show you what IS reporting, so the gap is invisible. Spatial observability renders it: the black hole where a service should be. Don't take our word for it. Go find it yourself.
Enter a live system Start free, no sales call

Always-On Demo

Running right now, unscripted, and nobody started it for you. It is one of our live grids, not a customer's system, but nothing about it is staged: we point chaos at it and hunt the gap live. Watch for a minute, send it to whoever is on call with you, or scroll on and go play with one yourself.

The demo grids

The live view above is showing one grid at a time, around the clock. Enter the demo to pick any of them and walk it yourself.
GridTypeWhat it shows
demo-shoebox Synthetic A small system you can break. Click a connection to break it, then watch the failure propagate and see exactly what it looks like in the telemetry. Synthetic, so nothing is precious and nothing pages anyone.
demo-snowglobe-ai-clean Synthetic AI, on a calm day. The agentic story without the noise.
demo-snowglobe-ai-flagship Synthetic An AI-native application, observed. Agentic and LLM calls most APMs cannot see inside.
demo-snowglobe-blended Synthetic The real world: traditional + AI together. Classic services and AI sharing one topology.
demo-snowglobe-incident Synthetic Everything is on fire. Maximum errors and dead consumers, the root-cause demo.
demo-snowglobe-phantom Synthetic Services you didn't know you had. Phantom detection: dead consumers inferred from the gaps.
demo-snowglobe-traditional Synthetic A traditional platform under strain. Classic services only, no AI, with the failures a normal production day actually produces.
demo-snowglobe-traditional-clean Synthetic A healthy e-commerce platform. The clean baseline, what good looks like.
demo-sos-apm Organic The people flat tools failed. Real observability pain from dev forums, surfaced to a human who replies in their own words, never the AI. When a fetcher dies, a phantom will appear.
demo-sos-ai Organic The people the AI moment is happening to. When someone is scared of AI, a person steps in to help, never the AI. No one here is a lead.

Enter a live system

A free account gets you in and lets you pick any demo grid, no subscription needed. Prefer to just watch first? The stream asks nothing at all.

DeepCube. The spatial observability platform.

Continuity, proximity, and memory as properties of the view, not filters you fight for.

Continuity

The same service, across time. The payments service today is the one you saw last Tuesday, wherever the layout draws it. Returning is a comparison, not a coincidence.

Proximity

What is near is already in frame. Stand at a node and the view scopes itself. No filter written, none babysat.

Memory

Your investigation persists. Your position, and what you have ruled out, survive navigation, across the incident, readable by the machine partner beside you.

DeepCube turns continuity, proximity, and memory into properties of the view, not filters you fight for. Built on OpenTelemetry with no vendor lock-in: bring any OTel-compatible collector and export your data anytime.

Industry Reality

  • The signal is scattered across tools, tabs, and dashboards, and the shape of the problem is in none of them.
  • Every context switch costs you the thread you were holding; navigating one space keeps it.
  • You understand a place faster than a panel: a case study of engineers reading complex software models found 3D visualization improved comprehension by 22% (3D Visualization for Model Comprehension, a case study at Ericsson AB).
  • Absence points at its own cause: a phantom does not just show the hole where a service should be, it shows the services still calling into it, so the gap tells you where to look.

One spatial view, not a wall of tabs

Logs, metrics, traces, and events layered in a single space you move through, so the shape of a problem is something you see rather than something you assemble across tabs.

Built for DevOps & SRE, infrastructure, support, and education. See it for your role: DevOps, SRE, Infrastructure, Support, Education.
